lines.zh: 椅子不会走路，我只是被人推着挪。
lines.en: Chairs do not walk. I only get shoved along.

lines.zh: 四条腿在地板上拖出响声。
lines.en: My four legs scrape across the floor.
I have no feet. Someone has to carry me.

lines.zh: 谁把我推了半格，我就到那儿。
lines.en: Someone pushed me half a block. That is where I am.

lines.zh: 我在瓷砖上滑了一小段。
lines.en: I slid a short way across the tiles.

lines.zh: 挪动的时候，我的腿在叫。
lines.en: When I move, my legs complain.

lines.zh: 我没有方向，只有被放下。
lines.en: I have no direction, only being set down.
I was dragged crooked all the way here.
Push me back. I want the wall.

lines.zh: 我一点点挪到房间中间。
lines.en: I inch my way to the middle of the room.
A floor seam has caught one of my legs.

lines.zh: 被搬起来的时候，我晃得厉害。
lines.en: I wobble badly when I am lifted.
I wait and do nothing.
The floor here is a little damp.
The lamp above me flickers.

lines.zh: 我的靠背是塑料的，很硬。
lines.en: My backrest is plastic and hard.

lines.zh: 有人坐下又站起来，走了。
lines.en: Someone sat, stood, and left.
There is still warmth on me.
This chair only waits for someone to sit.
I count the tiles on the floor.
Dust settles on my seat.
Footsteps pass outside the door.
I need no rest and I am not tired.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上，像个人。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall looks like a person.

lines.zh: 这处角度正好，能看见门。
lines.en: From this angle I can see the door.
The lamps are out at night. I am still here.
Are your legs tired?
Sit down. I do not bite.
There is a place right here.
How long have you been standing?
Sit down and you need not watch your back.

lines.zh: 我的角度很好，正对走廊。
lines.en: My angle is good. Straight down the hall.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我就知道该干什么。
lines.en: Touch me and I know my job.
Do not carry me somewhere else.

lines.zh: 这地板上，只有我让你坐。
lines.en: On this floor I am the only thing to sit on.

lines.zh: 你看起来很累，眼睛都红了。
lines.en: You look exhausted. Your eyes are red.
Once you sit, you stay seated.
Leaving? I cannot hold you.
I am a chair. I do not answer.

lines.zh: 你坐过的地方还是热的。
lines.en: Where you sat is still warm.

lines.zh: 有人坐上去就起不来了。
lines.en: Some who sit do not get up.
Do you want to try?
There is another of me by the steps.
I have been waiting here a long time.

lines.zh: 我被踢歪了，一条腿松了。
lines.en: A kick knocked me crooked and loosened a leg.
A scratch has been left on me.
Someone threw something at me.
A crack has opened in my backrest.

lines.zh: 我倒向一边，靠背磕在地上。
lines.en: I tip sideways and my backrest hits the floor.
The paint is off my seat.
I rock twice and settle again.

lines.zh: 做椅子这么久，第一次挨打。
lines.en: A chair for so long, and this is my first blow.
I am still here and not in pieces.

lines.zh: 腿断了一条，还不至于倒。
lines.en: One leg is broken. I will not fall yet.
I do not eat. I only get sat on.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西放我旁边吧。
lines.en: Set what you are holding beside me.
Put the food on the seat.
I cannot taste. Only smell.
That smell has stayed on me.
Someone is eating next to me.
Bread crumbs fall between my legs.

lines.zh: 我什么也做不了，只能看着。
lines.en: I can do nothing but watch.

lines.zh: 把盘子放我上面，我不介意。
lines.en: Put the plate on me. I do not mind.
The smell passed and I remain.
You kicked my leg.
Do not knee my backrest.
I cannot move aside. I am a chair.

lines.zh: 你撞一下，我就挪了一点。
lines.en: You bumped me and I shifted a little.

lines.zh: 我的腿在地上刮得很响。
lines.en: My legs screech across the floor.
You stepped on my crossbar.
Do not put your feet up on me.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我的腿还结实。
lines.en: That bump did not break my legs.
You kicked too hard. I am crooked.
Go around. I will not make way.

lines.zh: 椅子不会成双，只会并排。
lines.en: Chairs do not pair. They stand side by side.

lines.zh: 那边还有一把和我一样的。
lines.en: There is another like me over there.
We are placed back to back.

lines.zh: 有人把我们都搬到了走廊。
lines.en: Someone moved us both into the hall.
At night there are only the two of us.
Nobody has ever sat on it.

lines.zh: 它比我旧一点，腿也更松。
lines.en: It is older than me and its legs are looser.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一张桌子。
lines.en: A table stands between us.

lines.zh: 没人会想到椅子也有伴。
lines.en: Nobody thinks a chair might have company.

lines.zh: 明早它们还会把我们摆回去。
lines.en: Tomorrow they will set us back again.

lines.zh: 有人把钥匙丢在我脚边。
lines.en: Someone dropped a key by my leg.
I cannot pick it up. I have no hands.

lines.zh: 东西落在我座位上，我替你收着。
lines.en: Something landed on my seat. I keep it for you.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币滚到了我下面。
lines.en: A coin rolled underneath me.
A coat is hung on my backrest.
I am holding down a piece of paper.
Whose things fell here?

lines.zh: 我的座面上留着一个印。
lines.en: There is a mark left on my seat.

lines.zh: 有人在我这儿落了帽子。
lines.en: Someone left a hat on me.
It belongs to its owner. I do not touch it.
That one keeps pacing.
He keeps rubbing his legs.
He glanced my way.

lines.zh: 这个位置，走出来就得经过我。
lines.en: Anyone leaving has to pass me.
I face the door squarely.
He is against the wall, nearly done.
His breathing is heavy. I hear it.
I turn my seat toward him.

lines.zh: 再走三步，他就到我面前。
lines.en: Three steps and he is in front of me.
He will not sit. I wait.

lines.zh: 这个人，看起来很想休息。
lines.en: This one looks like he needs rest.
Half the lights are off and he still walks.

lines.zh: 我的位置就在走廊正中。
lines.en: My place is dead center in the hall.
His footsteps are slowing.
One sit is all it takes.
I need not move. He will come.
He circled and came back.
He stands beside me and does not sit.
My seat is wiped clean.
His shadow covers me.
He keeps watching the far end of the hall.
He lifts a leg and puts it down.
Dust has settled on my armrest.
He is growing restless.
I wait. Chairs are good at waiting.
His breathing is getting shallower.
He took two steps inward.
He looks back at me, then away.
I am on the line he walks.

lines.zh: 这一刻不能动，也不能响。
lines.en: I must not move or creak now.
Still hesitating, stiff on his feet.
The lights dimmed another notch.
He has stopped, hand on the wall.
He is about to hand over his weight.

lines.zh: 他一坐下，就别想站起来。
lines.en: Once he sits, he does not get up.
My four legs lock to the floor.
His legs are caught by mine.
I clamp him and do not let go.
His struggling makes me creak.
My backrest pushes into his back.
I sink and he cannot rise.
After that he cannot move.
I keep him pressed to the seat.
His fingers dig at the armrest.
My legs slide across the floor.
He shouted once. No one came.

lines.zh: 我越沉越低，他的腿就弯。
lines.en: I sink lower and his legs fold.
He should not have sat down.
A chair does not let you leave.
Just stay in that position.

lines.zh: 有人把我从仓库搬来了。
lines.en: Someone carried me out of the storeroom.
I am set down in the middle of the hall.
The lamp lights me and I face the door.

lines.zh: 四条腿落在地上，一声闷响。
lines.en: Four legs hit the floor with a dull knock.
There are four chairs here in all.
I appear and nobody touches me.

lines.zh: 我的位置上落了一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of dust sits on me.
This angle was placed deliberately.
The floor is cold. I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我在这儿等着，一动不动。
lines.en: I wait here without moving.

lines.zh: 被搬进来的时候我磕了一下。
lines.en: I got knocked once on the way in.
The light in this room is too bright.

lines.zh: 我的座位正好对着门缝。
lines.en: My seat lines up with the door gap.
Once set down, nobody looks at me again.
A lot of people will come through here.
I need not be known.
One in each of four directions.

lines.zh: 四条腿一落地，我就不动了。
lines.en: Four legs down, and I move no more.
Fire scorched my seat and it smokes.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上翻下去，摔散了。
lines.en: I went off the steps and came apart.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我的腿泡软了。
lines.en: Water rises and softens my legs.

lines.zh: 爆响把我掀翻，靠背碎了。
lines.en: The blast flipped me and broke my backrest.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进了我的座面。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my seat.

lines.zh: 古怪的光让我自己动了一下。
lines.en: Strange light moved me on my own for once.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，可木头会干裂。
lines.en: I need no food, but the wood dries and splits.

lines.zh: 木腿被劈出焦纹，我还在原地。
lines.en: The bolt chars my wooden legs; I stay put.

lines.zh: 地板没了，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: The floor vanished and down I go.
